name: Khau hang
summary: Khẩu háng is tám rice steamed in the husk, dried, milled, and then steamed again until done.
howToEat: Steam the paddy, dry it, mill off the husk, then steam it until done.
seoTitle: Khau hang in Dien Bien Phu — steamed twice
seoDescription: Khẩu háng is tám rice steamed in the husk, dried, milled, and then steamed again until done.
